intro: Picture waking up, drawing the curtains in a high room, and seeing Si Racha Bay with Koh Loi stretched out in front of you, while the other side of the tower looks out on the green shadow of the mountains — Arize Hotel Sri Racha is a high-rise city hotel on Sukhumvit Road in Surasak, Si Racha district, right in the hillside center of town · it has been open since 2017 with 379 rooms in total, including 273 suites, and every room sits from the 4th floor up, so you get a full view · what a lot of people talk about is big rooms from 35 to 120 sqm with bay and mountain views, a pool and gym on the 5th floor, a jacuzzi, sauna, spa, and several restaurants, plus free parking · from about THB 1,300/night, rated 8.5 from 534 reviews on Trip.com

body.html: Who Arize Hotel Sri Racha is for — the shortest possible summary is that Arize Hotel Sri Racha is a high-rise hotel for people who want "big rooms, sea views, and a central Si Racha location" without paying a fortune · it is not a beachfront resort that puts you straight into the water in front of the hotel, and it is not a small boutique tucked down a quiet lane · it is a high-rise city hotel on Sukhumvit Road in Surasak, in the hillside center of Si Racha, a neighborhood that is home to people working in the industrial estates, Japanese families on assignment, and travelers stopping over before continuing on to Pattaya and Rayong · it has been open since 2017 with as many as 379 rooms, 273 of them suites, which gives you plenty of large-room options for families or long stays · real reviews line up on who suits this place: business travelers working in the Eastern industrial zones, families who want a big room with a sea view at a reachable price, and couples or groups of friends looking for a getaway close to Bangkok without going all the way to Pattaya · another group that calls it good value is people staying for a week or a month, because some suite types have a kitchenette and a washing machine built in, so daily life feels as convenient as an apartment · if you are after a quiet, luxurious beachfront resort, this may not be the answer, and you should look toward Bang Saen or Pattaya instead

Location and getting around — what Arize has going for it is sitting in central Si Racha on Sukhumvit Road, on the hillside Surasak side, which makes both the town and the main routes easy to reach · from the hotel it is about a 5-minute drive to Robinson Si Racha, the town's main shopping center with restaurants, a supermarket, and a cinema · it is near Kasetsart University Si Racha Campus and Wat Khao Phutthakhodom, only about 500 meters away, a popular spot to head up for views over the town and bay · for working travelers, the hotel is a convenient drive from the Laem Chabang Industrial Estate and Laem Chabang Port (about 10 km), as well as the Amata City and Pinthong industrial zones · importantly, it is only about a 15–20 min drive from Pattaya and around an hour from Suvarnabhumi and U-Tapao airports, which makes it a good base for both work and leisure · a lot of reviews praise the location for being "in the middle of everything," with walks to the Japanese district, ramen shops, and convenience stores around the hotel · one small note is that Sukhumvit Road through Si Racha gets fairly busy at rush hour, so if you have to reach Laem Chabang in the morning, allow extra time

"The bay view from the high rooms is gorgeous — I woke up, opened the curtains, and saw the sea and Koh Loi · the room was a lot bigger than I expected, just a five-minute drive to Robinson, and close to Laem Chabang too. Really convenient to stay here when you come for work."

Room types and decor — Arize has 379 rooms in total, all starting from the 4th floor up, so every room gets a high view · the entry level is the Superior Ocean View at 35 sqm, which, even as the smallest room, is bigger than the standard rooms at many hotels in the same neighborhood · stepping up are the Deluxe Mountain View and Deluxe Ocean View at 40 sqm, so you can pick a mountain or sea view to taste · next come the Junior Suite Ocean View at 48 sqm and the One Bedroom Suite at 58 sqm, whose standout feature is a kitchenette, fridge, and built-in washing machine, well suited to long stays · the largest is the Two Bedroom Suite Ocean View at up to 120 sqm, for big families or groups of friends · the decor is contemporary in bright tones, with large windows to catch the view and plenty of natural light, and balconies in some rooms · many reviews agree that the rooms are spacious, the ceilings high, the views good, and the in-room amenities complete, with a minibar, kettle, fridge, and the essentials · what makes it feel like good value is the amount of usable space for the price, which keeps it comfortable even over several nights · that said, some reviewers note that the finer points of the decor and the cleaning are not consistent across every room, which is worth checking when you take the room

Facilities, pool, and spa — the most talked-about highlight at Arize is the outdoor pool and gym on the 5th floor, looking out over the town and Si Racha Bay · late afternoon into the evening is the popular time for guests to head up to swim, sit and relax, and photograph the sunset over the bay · there is a poolside bar for ordering a drink to sip by the water · on top of that there is a jacuzzi, steam room, sauna, and spa to unwind after a day of sightseeing or work · the gym gets praise for the sea view that makes a workout more enjoyable than a typical enclosed gym · there is also an executive lounge, meeting and seminar rooms, and free parking to cover both work and conference travelers · to be honest, from the reviews the pool and jacuzzi can at times have issues with temperature or inconsistent upkeep, and the parking is mostly open-air so it gets fairly hot during the day — if these things matter to you, set realistic expectations, but in terms of value and views it does well at this price

Food and bars — the hotel has several restaurants · the main one is Fresh, an all-day-dining restaurant serving Thai, Asian, and international food, and the spot for the breakfast buffet · there is a separate Japanese restaurant and international fine dining, which fits the large Japanese community in Si Racha · plus a cafe and bakery for a late-morning coffee, and the poolside bar on the 5th floor · breakfast is where reviews clearly disagree — those who like it say the buffet has plenty of variety across Thai, Asian, and Western menus, the food is fresh, and the staff serve well · while those who criticize it feel that at times there are not enough staff, food is slow to be refilled, and the quality of some ingredients is only ordinary · for other meals the central location helps a lot, because there are plenty of restaurants, ramen shops, grill spots, and convenience stores around the hotel, so many people choose to eat out and alternate with eating in · overall, food at Arize is not the reason to stay in to eat, but a flexible and decent add-on for a stay in a town that already has plenty of options around it

Service — service is a point where reviews disagree quite a bit · those who were impressed say the staff are polite, patient, and helpful, especially the front desk and some of the restaurant team, who get praised as friendly and attentive · the overall atmosphere is quiet and unhurried · but to be fair, some voices in the reviews note that the team's responsiveness is not consistent at certain times, such as booking confirmations or check-in steps that were slow in some cases, and room care that is not always thorough · the picture you get is a hotel where "the service basics are good but consistency is still a gamble," depending on the time and how busy it is · the tip is that if you have a special request, such as a high-floor sea-view room or an early check-in, let them know ahead and confirm again before you travel

What real reviews say (praise and criticism) — pulling from Trip.com, Agoda, and TripAdvisor, the picture is fairly mixed · on the praise side: the bay and mountain views from the high rooms are gorgeous, the rooms are spacious with high ceilings and good value, the 5th-floor pool and gym have a great view, the central location is near Robinson and Laem Chabang, the suites have a kitchen and washing machine that suit long stays, and some staff give impressive service · on the criticism side: the things mentioned most often are inconsistent cleanliness and room care, with dust or stains turning up sometimes, unstable water temperature in the bathroom and jacuzzi, air-conditioning that takes a while to cool some rooms, breakfast service that is understaffed at peak hours, and open-air parking that is hot during the day · on TripAdvisor the score runs lower than other platforms because the sample is small and there are negative reviews about past management mixed in, while Trip.com, with as many as 534 reviews, rates it as high as 8.5 · most of these criticisms can be handled by choosing the right room, checking it on arrival, and setting the right expectations, rather than being a major problem that keeps people from coming back

"The 5th-floor pool has a lovely town view, and the suite was spacious with a kitchen and washing machine — comfortable for a long stay · the only downsides were that on the first day the bathroom hot water wasn't very steady, and the room wasn't cleaned all that thoroughly. I told them and they came and fixed it; next time I'll ask to check the room before taking the key."

Price comparison and value — the entry price for a Superior room is around THB 1,300/night at normal rates (roughly 39 dollars), and the year-round average works out to about THB 2,800–3,000/night depending on room type and timing · suites like the Junior Suite and One Bedroom Suite run from around THB 2,500 up into the several thousands depending on size and view, while the 120 sqm Two Bedroom Suite is higher than that · compared with other hotels in Si Racha town and the Laem Chabang area, Arize feels like very good value in terms of room space for the price, especially if you get a high-floor sea-view room or a suite with a kitchen for a long stay · what makes it even better value is the fairly large set of facilities — the pool, gym, sauna, jacuzzi, and free parking — which is not easy to find in a hotel at the same price · if you are planning to use Si Racha as a base for work in the industrial zones, or day-tripping to Pattaya, a big sea-view room at this price is real substance, in exchange for accepting that the consistency of service and upkeep is not as polished as a large chain hotel

What to know before you book — a few things help make the stay smoother · one, if the view matters to you, specifically request a high-floor Ocean View at the time of booking, because the mountain-view and sea-view rooms are not far apart in price but very different in feel · two, if you are staying several days or coming as a group, consider a suite with a kitchen and washing machine, which is better value and more convenient than a standard room · three, on cleanliness and in-room equipment, we suggest you check the room's condition when you take the key — the bathroom, the air-conditioning, and the general tidiness — and if you find anything off, tell the team to fix it right away · four, the parking is mostly open-air, so if you come by car during the day, be prepared for the heat · five, on long weekends and in the high season the sea-view rooms fill up fast, so book ahead and compare prices across several platforms, and pick a free cancellation rate first if your plans are not certain

The bottom line — from all the real reviews, Arize Hotel Sri Racha is the hotel best suited to people who want a big sea-view room in central Si Racha on a reachable budget, whether you are coming for work in the Eastern industrial zones, staying for a week, or using it as a base for day trips to Pattaya · rooms from 35 to 120 sqm, a 5th-floor pool and gym with bay views, suites with a kitchen and washing machine, and a location near Robinson, Laem Chabang, and Pattaya make it good value in space-for-price terms, to the point where it is not easy to find a rival in the area · if you are looking for a luxurious beachfront resort with flawless service at every point, or you are very sensitive to detail on cleanliness and consistency of service, this is one to approach with some allowance, and you should consider a large chain hotel in Bang Saen or Pattaya instead · but for a trip where you want a good-value sea-view room in central Si Racha with a fairly large set of facilities — Arize answers that need well, and it is the reason it earns 8.5 from more than 534 real reviews

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Arize Hotel Sri Racha

faq.q: Where is Arize Hotel Sri Racha, and where can you get to from there?
faq.a: The hotel is at 8/88 Moo 4, Sukhumvit Road, Surasak, Si Racha, Chonburi, in the hillside center of Si Racha · it is about a 5-minute drive to Robinson Si Racha, near Kasetsart University Si Racha Campus and Wat Khao Phutthakhodom (about 530 m) · close to the Laem Chabang estate and port (~10 km), about 15–20 minutes from Pattaya, and around an hour from Suvarnabhumi and U-Tapao airports

faq.q: What is the starting price at Arize Hotel Sri Racha, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 1,300/night for a Superior Ocean View at 35 sqm during normal rates · there is a Deluxe at 40 sqm (choice of sea or mountain view), a Junior Suite at 48 sqm, a One Bedroom Suite at 58 sqm with a kitchen and washing machine, up to a Two Bedroom Suite at 120 sqm · the year-round average runs about THB 2,800–3,000/night, so it is worth comparing several platforms before you book

faq.q: Who is Arize Hotel Sri Racha for?
faq.a: It is a great fit for business travelers working in the Eastern industrial zones, families who want a big sea-view room, and people on week-long stays, because some suite types have a kitchen and washing machine · it is also convenient as a base for day trips to Pattaya · if you are looking for a luxurious beachfront resort with flawless service, a large chain hotel in Bang Saen or Pattaya may suit you more

faq.q: What pool and facilities does Arize Hotel Sri Racha have?
faq.a: There is an outdoor pool and gym on the 5th floor with views over the town and Si Racha Bay, plus a poolside bar · there is a jacuzzi, steam room, sauna, spa, executive lounge, meeting and seminar rooms, and free parking · there are several restaurants including the all-day-dining Fresh, a Japanese-international restaurant, and a bakery cafe

faq.q: What are cleanliness and service like at Arize, and how should you prepare?
faq.a: Reviews disagree — those who like it praise the spacious rooms, lovely views, and friendly staff · those who criticize it mention inconsistent cleanliness and room care, unstable water temperature, and service at times that you have to wait for · we suggest you check the room's condition when you take the key, including the bathroom, air-conditioning, and tidiness, then tell the team to fix it right away if you find a problem

faq.q: Is Arize Hotel Sri Racha still open, and what is its review score?
faq.a: It is still open and operating normally · it has been open since 2017 · the latest score is 8.5 from 534 reviews on Trip.com, with many reviews praising the sea views, big rooms, and value · on some platforms with a smaller sample the score is lower because there are reviews about service consistency mixed in, so compare several sources before you decide
